answer: By the canyon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Work waits on the basalt until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the willow of the next round. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
